protocol.purpose: Protocol-frozen holdout evaluation of evidence-gated method admission on newly selected public engineering data that were not used for v7 development.

freeze.result_policy: A full result is valid only after status is frozen, both revisions identify the preceding committed candidate, and evaluation_fingerprint matches the algorithm, adapters, data, dependencies, and normalized protocol.

threshold_rule.rationale: Fixed-prevalence evaluation device within each categorical context; not a building specification.

mechanism_features.name: envelope_area
mechanism_features.basis: Wall and roof area jointly proxy the heat-transfer envelope.

mechanism_features.name: glazing_exposure_proxy
mechanism_features.basis: Surface area times glazing fraction proxies exposed glazing area.

mechanism_features.name: compactness_height_interaction
mechanism_features.basis: Building compactness and height interact in envelope geometry.

threshold_rule.rationale: Fixed-prevalence evaluation device; not a complete motor-control objective.

mechanism_features.name: active_load_proxy
mechanism_features.basis: Current times power factor is proportional to active-load contribution at fixed voltage.

mechanism_features.name: error_correction_interaction
mechanism_features.basis: Requested excitation change interacts with the remaining power-factor error.

mechanism_features.name: correction_per_load
mechanism_features.basis: Excitation correction relative to load separates scale from control response.

claim_boundary.permitted_if_passed: On the frozen v4 public engineering-data evaluation, evidence-gated method admission required fewer additional result queries than every preregistered baseline while preserving the success-rate and evaluation-unit guardrails.
not_permitted: The same reduction applies to another factory, process, material, machine, building, or objective.
Offline pool replay proves prospective production-cycle reduction.
Mechanism features are validated physical laws or confirmed causes.
Development tuning on v3 is independent evidence.
